Lassa virus infection; most infections are asymptomatic or mild, and lasting organ injury or hearing loss does not affect >=30% across this umbrella.
Premature cranial suture fusion defines the disorder; strabismus occurs in 11/72 and developmental or brain abnormalities are much less frequent.
Malignant meningeal tumour arising within the central nervous system.
